run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T13:22:11Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend is explained by frontend errors confined to the GET /api/data route and its AdService client call: frontend error spans are only on GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (client) and 'tcp.connect', and the frontend error rate went from 0 to ~0.3-1.07 errors/s starting at the 13:23:11 sample. A pre-incident trace proves the call path frontend GET -> GET /api/data -> executing api route (pages) /api/data -> client grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds -> ad server oteldemo.AdService/GetAds. The ad backend then disappeared: at 13:21:09 the ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w was stopped and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 was scaled down 1->0, at 13:21:19 the deployment was scaled back up 0->1, and from 13:21:19 to 13:26:47 ten FailedCreate events show the replacement pod forbidden by ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory ('requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'). The quota's used (1901Mi) already exceeds its hard (~1433.5Mi) and equals exactly the sum of the 20 running pods' memory requests, so no new ad pod can be admitted. Ad now has no pod, deployment ready/available are absent with unavailable=1, and both Service ad and Endpoints ad have no subsets, so frontend's GetAds calls fail at connection time (tcp.connect error spans) and /api/data returns errors. ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans show no error status and stop at the 13:22:11 sample, consistent with failed calls never reaching ad. frontend-proxy also shows its own concurrent error spans (ingress 509.26, router frontend egress 501.11 over 76m) that surged from a sporadic baseline at 13:23:11; the propagation link to the frontend 5xx is plausible but unverified because Jaeger holds no traces after ~13:20:27.

claims.text: Over the 76m window frontend's error spans are concentrated on one path: 'GET /api/data' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 491.94, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' ERROR 491.94, 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (client) ERROR 491.94, 'GET' ERROR 491.94 and 'tcp.connect' ERROR 17.31, while 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart', 'POST /api/checkout', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' error series are all 0 (those calls themselves counted 1559.35, 3241.94, 1065.37, 4801.30, 1065.37 and 16977.69 as STATUS_CODE_UNSET).

The frontend error rate (5m rate of spans with STATUS_CODE_ERROR) was exactly 0 for every sample from 13:03:11 to 13:21:11, first became nonzero (0.3148/s) at the 13:23:11 sample, peaked at 1.0667/s at 13:25:11 and was still 0.4468/s at 13:33:11; the identical curve appears for 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', and 'tcp.connect' rose from 0 with it (0.0333/s at 13:23:11).

A trace at 13:20:27 shows the request path that fails during the alert: frontend 'GET' -> 'GET /api/data' -> 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' -> frontend client 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' -> ad server 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (span_id 1e0649b5f6520293, rpc.grpc.status_code 0) -> ad 'getAdsByCategory'; all spans in that trace carry success status (http 200 / grpc 0).

The ad service's own GetAds server operation shows no error status at all in the 76m window: 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' STATUS_CODE_UNSET = 1137.685 and no 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exists; the only ad-side error series returned is 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' ERROR = 1.022.

Ad server GetAds spans were produced at 80-146 per minute through the 13:21:11 sample, fell to 50 in the 13:22:11 sample and were exactly 0 from the 13:23:11 sample onward, so the ad backend stopped serving in the same minutes the frontend GetAds errors appeared.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo show: 13:21:09 Normal Killing 'Stopping container ad' on pod ad-554b849958-p226w; 13:21:09 Normal SuccessfulDelete of pod ad-554b849958-p226w; 13:21:09 Normal ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0'; 13:21:19 Normal ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1'; then 10 Warning FailedCreate events (13:21:19 through 13:26:47) with the exact text 'Error creating: pods "ad-554b849958-..." is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'.
ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo has spec.hard memory=1503238553600m (about 1433.5Mi) and status.used memory=1901Mi, i.e. current usage already exceeds the hard cap.

The 20 running otel-demo pods' memory requests sum to exactly 1901Mi (160+55+128+4+50+120+250+200+100+25+5+300+100+150+80+50+15+20+80+5+4Mi across containers), which matches the quota's used value; the ad deployment's container requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi with limits 50m / 450Mi, exactly the 225Mi the FailedCreate events say was refused.

Deployment ad in otel-demo has desired replicas 1 but status.readyReplicas and status.availableReplicas are absent and status.unavailableReplicas is 1; the other 20 deployments in the namespace (including frontend) each report desired 1 / ready 1 / available 1. The namespace's pod list contains 20 Running pods, none owned by an ad ReplicaSet, and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owner Deployment ad) has spec.replicas 1 but status.replicas 0 and no ready count.

Service 'ad' (port 8080 -> targetPort 8080) has no subsets and Endpoints 'ad' (labels app.kubernetes.io/name=ad, opentelemetry.io/name=ad) has no subsets, i.e. the ad Service currently has zero ready endpoints.

Deployment ad still has spec.replicas 1 and pod template revision annotation 'deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: 1' while metadata.generation is 3 and the pod image is ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, so the deployment's desired state is one replica of the same pod template and only its replica control changed (no pod-template revision bump).

frontend-proxy has its own error spans over the 76m window: 'ingress' 509.259 and 'router frontend egress' 501.111; its error rate had only a sporadic baseline (0.0037-0.0074/s) before jumping to 0.3296/s at the 13:23:11 sample and about 1.05/s at 13:25:11, the same onset as the frontend errors.

The by-service error-span totals over 76m were frontend 1985.09, frontend-proxy 1010.37, recommendation 3.056, fraud-detection 2.042, ad 1.022, accounting 0 and payment 0; no error series was returned for the other available service names, so their error counts are unknown rather than zero.

Primary cause: frontend's /api/data requests fail because the ad backend has no serving pod, so frontend's client GetAds calls fail at connection time. The ad pod was stopped at 13:21:09 when ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 was scaled 1->0, the 13:21:19 scale-up 0->1 could not create a pod because ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory is already over its hard limit (used 1901Mi vs hard ~1433.5Mi, ad would need a further 225Mi), the ad Service/Endpoints have no subsets, frontend GetAds + tcp.connect errors start at the 13:23:11 sample, and ad server GetAds spans stop at 13:22:11 with no ad-side error status.

Secondary: frontend-proxy's 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error spans are HTTP responses propagated from frontend's failing /api/data route rather than a proxy defect. Only concurrency (identical onset at the 13:23:11 sample) is observed; the parent-child link cannot be verified because no traces exist after 13:20:27.

The quota was already over-committed before 13:21 (ad's 225Mi was running on top of the other pods' 1901Mi while hard is ~1433.5Mi), so either the ResourceQuota hard value was lowered or pod requests grew at some earlier point; the change that produced this state is not observable in the delivered data.

ad itself was not returning application-level errors: its 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' spans are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET (1137.685 over 76m, close to frontend's 1141.759 successful GetAds spans) with no GetAds ERROR series, so the 491.94 failed frontend GetAds spans have no ad-side counterpart and failed before being served.

Rejected: the ad service's 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' span with error=true / rpc.grpc.status_code=4 caused the frontend error rate. It is a single occurrence, started 13:06:41 and lasted ~600s (ended ~13:16:41), i.e. it ended before the ad pod was stopped at 13:21:09 and before frontend errors began at the 13:23:11 sample, and the ad-side GetAds operation shows no errors.

Restore capacity for the ad workload: raise the otel-demo-memory ResourceQuota hard limit above the namespace's 1901Mi of memory requests (plus the 225Mi the ad pod needs) or reduce other pods' memory requests, so the pending ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can create its pod; then verify Service/Endpoints 'ad' gain a ready subset and that the frontend GetAds / /api/data error rate returns to 0.

Review what set Deployment ad's replicas from 1 to 0 at 13:21:09 and back to 1 at 13:21:19 (generation 3 with pod-template revision still 1), and review the change that left otel-demo-memory over-committed, using change history, which is not integrated in this Run.

gaps: No change-history integration is available, so what lowered the otel-demo-memory quota hard limit (or raised pod requests) and what scaled Deployment ad 1->0->1 at 13:21:09/13:21:19 cannot be attributed.

Jaeger holds no traces after ~13:20:27 (queries for frontend traces in 13:21-13:38 and for error tags returned no traces), so the failing GetAds spans could not be inspected in trace detail: exact gRPC status codes and the parent-child link between /api/data, GetAds and tcp.connect during the error period are unverified.

fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 returned 0 lines for 13:10-13:38 (current container read returned nothing and there is no previous instance), so there is no application-log evidence for the frontend errors.
rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count for service_name=frontend returned no series in this window, so frontend gRPC client status-code labels are unknown.

kube-state-metrics kube_deployment* series are not present in this Prometheus for the window (get_metric_names returned nothing and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready/available/unavailable queries returned no data), so there is no historical replica timeline; deployment/ReplicaSet state was taken from the Kubernetes API and events instead.
list_prometheus_rules returned no rule named RequestErrorRate, so the alert's exact expression and numerator/denominator are unknown.
Requests for horizontalpodautoscalers in otel-demo returned no objects/no_data, so autoscaler involvement in the 13:21 scale change is unverified.
The ad pod no longer exists, so its logs and its own error/status evidence during the incident are unavailable; only its deployment, ReplicaSet, Service, Endpoints and events could be read.
frontend-proxy error spans are observed but their payload/status codes are unknown, so whether they carry the frontend 5xx is a hypothesis.
recommendation (3.056) and fraud-detection (2.042) error-span counts were observed but not investigated; no evidence ties them to this cause.
next_steps: Check change history for ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (hard memory 1503238553600m) and for Deployment ad replicas to identify who/what caused the 13:21 scale cycle and the quota over-commit.
Raise the otel-demo-memory quota or lower memory requests so the 225Mi ad pod can be admitted, then confirm Endpoints 'ad' has a ready subset and frontend GetAds//api/data error spans stop.
Extend trace retention past the incident minute or enable a metrics query on frontend gRPC client status codes so the failed GetAds status (e.g. UNAVAILABLE) can be confirmed directly.
Capture frontend and frontend-proxy logs during the error period to confirm the HTTP 5xx and the connection error text.

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.

view.series_note: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation of the service (internal, client and server spans alike), summed over the labels kept in this query; it is not a count of requests. status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status; it does not mean the call succeeded.

view.span_groups_note: span_groups summarizes the spans shown in content; spans the adapter sampled out are not counted in any group.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). <none> means the path reached no value in that object, not that the field is absent from the kind; a filtered table is not a full picture of the kind.
